teaser.en: Its hard grey seeds are cast to 'foretell' what lies ahead, for one person or a whole community.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake ngumu za kijivu hutupwa ili 'kutabiri' yaliyo mbele, kwa mtu mmoja au kwa jamii nzima.
teaser.dg: Tembeze ngumu za rangi ya ivu nkutsuphwa ili 'kutabiri' gadzago, kpwa mutu mmwenga au kpwa atu osi a mudzi.

summary.en: *Mburuga* is a prickly scrambling shrub whose spiny pods hold hard grey seeds like marbles. Its name means 'foretell', and the fruits are used in divination.
summary.sw: *Mburuga* (kwa Kiingereza *grey nicker*) ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa, ambacho maganda yake yenye miiba hubeba mbegu ngumu za kijivu kama gololi. Jina lake lina maana ya 'tabiri', na matunda yake hutumika katika uaguzi.
summary.dg: *Mburuga* ni chitsaka chinachoambala chenye miya, ambacho makakayage genye miya ganakala na tembe ngumu za rangi ya ivu dza magololi. Dzinare rina mana ya 'kutabiri', na matundage nkuhumirwa kpwa mlamulo.

about.en:
*Mburuga* is a scrambling, sprawling shrub armed with hooked prickles on its stems and leaves. The leaves are large and twice divided into many oval leaflets. Spikes of small yellow flowers are followed by flat pods covered in stiff spines.

Inside each pod are one or two hard seeds, smooth, grey and round like marbles. The seeds are so hard and buoyant that they can drift on ocean currents and wash up on beaches far away.
about.sw:
*Mburuga* ni kichaka kinachotambaa na kutanda, chenye miiba iliyopinda kama kulabu kwenye mashina na majani. Majani ni makubwa na yamegawanyika mara mbili kuwa vijani vingi vya umbo la yai. Mashada ya maua madogo ya manjano hufuatwa na maganda bapa yaliyofunikwa na miiba migumu.

Ndani ya kila ganda kuna mbegu moja au mbili ngumu, laini, za kijivu na za mviringo kama gololi. Mbegu hizi ni ngumu na huelea vizuri kiasi kwamba zinaweza kuchukuliwa na mikondo ya bahari na kutupwa kwenye fukwe za mbali.
about.dg:
*Mburuga* ni chitsaka chinachoambala na kutawanyika, chenye miya ya kupindika kpwenye makolo na makodza. Makodza ni makulu, na ganaganywa mara mbiri kukala makodza madide manji ga mviringo. Bada ya mafungu mare ga maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano kunamera makakaya mabapa ganayofwinikpwa ni miya migumu.

Ndani ya chila kakaya kuna tembe mwenga au mbiri, ngumu, laini, za rangi ya ivu na za mviringo dza magololi. Tembe hizi ni ngumu sana na zinaelea, hata zinaweza kuelea baharini na kutsukulwa ni madzi hadi pwani za kure.

where.en: *Mburuga* grows in coastal thicket and on forest edges, often forming prickly tangles. Near the shore it scrambles over other bushes. The spiny pods are easiest to spot once they ripen and turn brown.
where.sw: *Mburuga* hukua katika vichaka vizito vya pwani na pembezoni mwa misitu, mara nyingi ukiunda vichaka vilivyosokotana vyenye miiba. Karibu na ufukwe hutambaa juu ya vichaka vingine. Maganda yenye miiba ni rahisi zaidi kuyaona yanapoiva na kugeuka rangi ya hudhurungi.
where.dg: *Mburuga* unamera kahi ya vitsaka vya pwani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, mara nyinji uchihenda mafungu ga miya ganayotsanganyika. Phephi na pwani unaambala dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina. Makakaya genye miya ni rahisi kugaona ganaphoivwa na kukala ga rangi ya dongo.

uses.en: The seeds of *mburuga* are used in divination. The grey seeds of related *Caesalpinia* are also used as counters in *bao*, the board game played across the coast.
uses.sw: Mbegu za *mburuga* hutumika katika uaguzi. Mbegu za kijivu za *Caesalpinia* jamaa pia hutumika kama kete katika *bao*, mchezo wa ubao unaochezwa kote pwani.
uses.dg: Tembe za *mburuga* nkuhumirwa kpwa mlamulo. Tembe za rangi ya ivu za *Caesalpinia* za phephi piya nkuhumirwa dza tembe za kucheza *bao*, mchezo wa ubao unaochezwa pwani yosi.

culture.en: *Mburuga* means 'foretell'. Its fruits are used to predict events, both for individuals and for whole communities. A seed that is hard to break and travels across the sea is a fitting tool for looking ahead.
culture.sw: *Mburuga* lina maana ya 'tabiri'. Matunda yake hutumika kutabiri matukio, kwa watu binafsi na kwa jamii nzima. Mbegu ambayo ni vigumu kuivunja na inayosafiri kuvuka bahari ni chombo kinachofaa kwa kuangalia yajayo.
culture.dg: *Mburuga* rina mana ya 'kutabiri'. Matundage nkuhumirwa kutabiri gadzago, kpwa mutu mmwenga na kpwa atu osi a mudzi. Tembe isiyovundzika rahisi na inayovuka bahari ni chombo chinachofwaha kulola gadzago.

names.en: Digo: *mburuga*, also *mbate* and *mtera*. Swahili: *mburuga*. The name *mburuga* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. English: grey nicker or bonduc. Scientists call it *Caesalpinia bonduc*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mburuga*, pia *mbate* na *mtera*. Kiswahili: *mburuga*. Jina *mburuga* linatumika katika Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kiingereza: *grey nicker* au *bonduc*. Wanasayansi huuita *Caesalpinia bonduc*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mburuga*, piya *mbate* na *mtera*. Chiswahili: *mburuga*. Dzina *mburuga* ni ra Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili piya. Chingereza: *grey nicker* au *bonduc*. Asayansi anauiha *Caesalpinia bonduc*.
